title: Event A1 (Serving becomes better than threshold)

entities.name: Event A1
entities.description: Measurement event triggered when serving cell becomes better than threshold. UE evaluates entering and leaving conditions based on measurement results and configured parameters.

entities.name: Entering condition A1-1
entities.description: Condition satisfied when Ms + Hys > Thresh, where Ms is serving cell measurement, Hys is hysteresis, Thresh is threshold.

entities.name: Leaving condition A1-2
entities.description: Condition satisfied when Ms - Hys < Thresh, where Ms is serving cell measurement, Hys is hysteresis, Thresh is threshold.

entities.name: Ms (Measurement result)
entities.description: Measurement result of the serving cell without offsets, expressed in dBm for RSRP or dB for RSRQ/RS-SINR.

entities.name: Hys (Hysteresis)
entities.description: Hysteresis parameter for Event A1 defined in reportConfigNR, expressed in dB.

entities.name: Thresh (Threshold)
entities.description: Threshold parameter for Event A1 (a1-Threshold) defined in reportConfigNR, expressed in same unit as Ms.

entities.name: measObjectNR
entities.description: Measurement object NR associated with Event A1 that identifies the serving cell to be measured.

relations.description: Event A1 entering condition is guarded by condition A1-1 (Ms + Hys > Thresh)
Event A1 leaving condition is guarded by condition A1-2 (Ms - Hys < Thresh)
Condition A1-1 requires measurement result Ms from serving cell
Condition A1-1 requires hysteresis parameter Hys
Condition A1-1 requires threshold parameter Thresh
Condition A1-2 requires measurement result Ms from serving cell
Condition A1-2 requires hysteresis parameter Hys
Condition A1-2 requires threshold parameter Thresh
Event A1 requires measObjectNR to identify the serving cell to be measured
